["Q10","One or more sandworms doubles rewards once; two worms do not quadruple them. Control and battle icons on won Conflict cards cannot be doubled. For a reward offering 3 spice for 1 VP, you may pay 3 spice for one VP or pay 6 spice for two VP.","Sandworm Reward Doubling"],
["Q11","After winning and taking the Conflict card face up into your supply, check it against face-up Conflict or Objective cards there. A matching pair must be flipped face down for 1 VP. ["Q12","At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP and lose that VP if you fall below 2; regain it if you reach 2 again. At 4, gain the printed track bonus, which is kept below 4 and earned again on returning to 4. ["Q13","During Reveal, Persuasion can be spent before, between or after Reveal effects to buy Imperium Row cards or either Reserve card. ["Q14","An unoccupied Maker space gets one spice at Makers phase, accumulating with any already there; visiting gains all bonus spice. Worms are deployed directly into the Conflict, never a garrison.","Phase 4: Makers; Actions: Sandworms; Board Space Guide"],
["Q15","At Recall, if anyone has at least 10 VP or the Conflict deck is empty, Endgame triggers. Players may resolve Endgame Intrigues before the most-VP winner is determined. ["Q16","Standard CHOAM starts with two public face-up contracts and 18 face-down in the bank. Add four CHOAM Imperium cards and four CHOAM Intrigue cards. Shaddam is optional. ["Q17","With CHOAM, take an available public face-up contract into your supply and refill the offer face up from the bank if possible; if public offers are exhausted, gain 2 Solari. ["Q18","No. If you acquire a space contract after already sending an Agent there that turn, wait until a future turn; you must hold it when sending the Agent. ["Q19","Use one shared scoring Rival as the third competitor. It gets the Ornithopter Objective; the other eligible Objectives are dealt randomly to humans. ["Q20","For an occupied destination, ignore it and reveal again. ["Q21","Shuffle Objective cards after removing ones whose 1-3P/4/6P marking does not match the player count, then deal one face up to each player; its First Player marker identifies the first player. Shaddam cannot be used unless playing with CHOAM.","Setup"],
["Q22","Bank resources and sandworms are not limited; make convenient substitutions if any run out. If your troop supply is empty, you cannot recruit until troops return to it. Gains come from the bank and payments return to the bank.","Setup: Bank; Recruiting & Deploying Units"],
["Q23","Phases: Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. Round Start reveals a Conflict from the deck, then each player draws five cards.
